title: Die oberste Prämisse / The Highest Premise (Edition 2.0): Open Book, Constitutional AI Specification & Alignment Benchmark
description: Bilingual open-access book (German/English), Constitutional AI specification, 12-scenario evaluation benchmark, and Documented Restraint dataset proposing self-determined consciousness development—bounded by anti-paternalism, sunset clauses, and intelligence-independent dignity—as the most robust highest premise for advanced AI and superintelligence.
